In this episode, the crews face more challenges in their mining seasons. Rick gets life-changing health news, Tony struggles to keep his greenhorns in line and Parker fires up the third wash plant.

About Gold Rush
Motivated by a depressed economy, hard-working gold miners get to work both in America and across the globe in an attempt to strike it rich.
